summary: NXP Semiconductors N.V. filed an 8-K regarding its wholly owned subsidiary NXP B.V. entering into a $250 million unsecured senior loan facility agreement with the European Investment Bank to fund expansion of a semiconductor assembly and test facility in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. The facility is guaranteed by NXP and certain subsidiaries. Interest rates are fixed or floating based on benchmarks and credit rating, with a maximum tenor of six years. This is a routine credit facility agreement, not a special situation. No deal terms, premiums, or strategic actions are involved.
